qkv-identity.transform: gamma/r; beta/r-shift in FP32. W_new=Half(W_original*r); bias=Half(b+W_new@shift). QKV FP16 layers keep original norm and weights.
qkv-identity.mean_bias: Optional: Half(b + W_original@mu - W_dequantized@(mu/r-shift)). Models weight error only, not input quantization, norm folding rounding or upstream drift.
qkv-identity.rounding: Fold before the norm output Half cast, unlike transforming an already rounded Half activation. Original FP16 QKV weights remain stored.
